notes: Current public Vagaro directory and booking pages supported professional or business identity, Colorado city, selected category, and booking access.
No authored bios, reviews, ratings, credentials, photos, or portfolio media were copied.
Production deduplication used exact source URL and normalized name plus city.
Imported rows retain user_id=NULL and claim_status='unclaimed'.
An initial transaction using the repository-documented makeup_artist category was rejected and rolled back because the current production category constraint does not yet accept makeup_artist.
Listings were retained only where the same source page explicitly supported an existing production category such as brows, lashes, waxing, or hair; no unsupported category was forced.
